description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointing Piyasena Ranasinghe Esquire to be a Commissioner of the Commission of Inquiry
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the appointment of a High Court Judge (Piyasena Ranasinghe Esquire) to a Commission of Inquiry. This falls under judicial appointments and matters related to the functioning of commissions, which is classified under Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement Gazettes) for court and judicial officer appointments.
